study type: Post-hoc analysis of three Phase II and III, multi-center, double blind, randomized controlled trials
cohort: 401 women with hypertensive disorders during pregnancy
finding: After adjusting for confounders, time-to-event outcomes for induction of labor using misoprostol vaginal insert or dinoprostone vaginal insert in women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy are not significantly different from women without hypertensive disorders.
mod_finding: This study found that after adjusting for confounders, there were no significant differences in time-to-vaginal delivery outcomes for labor induction using misoprostol or dinoprostone in women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy compared to those without.
